push notification.note: Plural: 'notificări push'. Legacy webapp calque 'Notificare Împinge' is an error — never reuse.

share extension.note: OS-level share feature; matches iOS/Android Romanian terminology.

bottom sheet.note: No repo signal; descriptive rendering of the Material 'bottom sheet'.

long-press.note: Verb form: 'a apăsa lung' ('apăsați lung pe mesaj').

toast.note: Brief on-screen confirmation; avoid the untranslated developer term 'toast' in user-facing text.

clipboard.note: Kept untranslated per Windows/Android Romanian convention ('copiat în clipboard').

biometrics.note: Adjectival use: 'autentificare biometrică'. Mobile ro.json currently paraphrases it away ('cod de acces') — use the explicit term.

passcode.note: Established in mobile ro.json ('securizat cu un cod de acces').

jailbroken.note: Kept untranslated in mobile ro.json ('Dispozitivele jailbroken'); pair with 'rooted' for Android the same way.

Face ID.note: Apple brand; mobile ro.json once renders 'ID-ul feței' — keep 'Face ID' untranslated.

deep link.note: No repo signal; 'link direct' reads naturally for links that open a specific screen. The English 'deep link' may be kept in technical/admin contexts.

server connection.note: 'Add a server' = 'Adăugați un server'; 'Switch server' = 'Schimbați serverul'.
